question: Day 1's price is 1, cheaper than day 0's 7. What should happen?
context: The cheapest morning so far is day 0 at 7.

choices.label: Make day 1 the buying day
choices.feedback: Right. Any later sale earns more if it buys at 1 instead of 7, so day 1 replaces day 0 as the cheapest morning.

choices.label: Sell on day 1
choices.feedback: Selling at 1 after buying at 7 loses money. A cheaper day is a better place to buy, not to sell.

choices.label: Ignore it: day 0 was already chosen
choices.feedback: Then a sale at 6 on day 4 would earn only −1 instead of 5. Always buy at the cheapest morning seen so far.
